# Statement of Work

**RelayAI — Statement of Work**

---

**Client:** ____________________
**Date:** ____________________
**Prepared by:** RelayAI

---

## 1. Project Overview

RelayAI will build and deploy a custom AI agent for [CLIENT BUSINESS NAME] to handle inbound customer enquiries. The agent will operate 24/7, responding to customers via [WhatsApp / web chat / both], collecting lead information, answering common questions, and escalating complex requests to the team.

## 2. Objectives

- Reduce response time for customer enquiries to under 30 seconds
- Capture lead contact details automatically into [HubSpot / Splose / Google Sheets]
- Handle common FAQs without human intervention
- Ensure no enquiry goes unanswered outside business hours

## 3. Scope of Work

### In Scope

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Channel setup** | [WhatsApp Business via Twilio / Web chat widget / Both] |
| **CRM integration** | [HubSpot / Splose / Google Sheets] — create leads, search existing contacts |
| **Agent capabilities** | Answer FAQs, collect contact details, [check availability / book appointments], escalate to human |
| **System prompt** | Custom-written based on discovery call, covering business info, services, pricing, hours |
| **Testing** | Internal testing + 1-2 rounds of client feedback and prompt tuning |
| **Deployment** | Widget installed on client website / WhatsApp webhook configured |
| **Handover** | Walkthrough of CRM integration, how to check leads, who to contact for support |

### Out of Scope

- Changes to the client's website design or functionality (beyond adding the widget snippet)
- CRM setup or configuration beyond API integration (e.g., custom HubSpot pipelines, reports)
- Multi-language support
- Voice/phone call handling
- Custom integrations not listed above

## 4. Deliverables

1. **Configured AI agent** — live and responding on agreed channels
2. **CRM integration** — leads automatically appearing in client's CRM
3. **System prompt documentation** — copy of the agent's knowledge base and instructions
4. **Widget snippet** — ready to paste into client's website (if applicable)
5. **Handover documentation** — how to check leads, escalation process, support contact

## 5. Timeline

| Phase | Duration | Activities |
|-------|----------|------------|
| Discovery | Day 1 | Discovery call, requirements gathering |
| Build | Days 2-3 | Tenant setup, system prompt, CRM integration, channel config |
| Test | Days 3-5 | Internal testing, client testing, prompt refinement |
| Go Live | Day 5-7 | Deploy to production, monitor, handover |

**Total estimated timeline: 5-7 business days from kickoff.**

## 6. Client Requirements

To deliver on time, we need the following from the client:

- [ ] Business information: services, pricing, hours, location, common FAQs
- [ ] CRM access: API key or credentials for [HubSpot / Splose / Google Sheets]
- [ ] Website access: ability to add a script tag (if using web widget)
- [ ] WhatsApp: Twilio account or willingness to set one up (if using WhatsApp)
- [ ] Nominated contact for escalations (name, email, phone)
- [ ] Availability for a 30-min testing/feedback session during the Test phase

## 7. Ongoing Service

After go-live, the agent operates under the selected monthly plan:

- **Plan:** [Starter / Growth / Custom]
- **Included:** Up to [100 / 500 / X] conversations per month
- **Support:** Email support during business hours, system prompt updates as needed
- **Monitoring:** Usage and performance reviewed monthly

## 8. Assumptions

- Client will provide accurate business information within 2 business days of kickoff
- Response quality is directly tied to the quality of information provided
- The agent handles text-based enquiries only (no voice, images, or video)
- Standard response latency is under 10 seconds for most queries
